# SEO-173: Derive review and rating markup only from real collected reviews

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

| Confidence | `HIGH` |

## Statement

Every review, rating, and aggregate rating property is computed from reviews the site actually holds and displays, and no such property is emitted for an item that has received none.

## Rationale

Rating markup that is not backed by collected reviews is fabricated data about a real-world subject, which is prohibited by published policy and cannot be corrected later by editing the number.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ],
  "any": [
    "has_structured_data",
    "ecommerce",
    "ugc"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Read the count and average from the review store at render time and omit the whole property when the count is zero. An automated agent must not create, seed, estimate, or default any review or rating value, and must report the absence instead.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Trace each emitted rating value back to the stored review records it summarises and report any value with no records behind it.
- Evidence: `JSON_LD`, `RENDERED_HTML`, `MANUAL_ACTION`
- Automated check: `jsonld-review-without-source`
